name: YTL
recent: YTL 近期持续因凭单转换与 ESOS 行使而分批发行新股，同时 EPF 在 10 月至 11 月初多次申报持股变动。公司将于 12 月 3 日召开第 43 届常年股东大会，并寻求股东批准更新股票回购授权。
notable: 凭单转换为普通股，多次发行新股，转换价为每股 RM1.50。
ESOS 行使期权发行新股，行使价为每股 RM0.46。
将于 2026 年 12 月 3 日召开第 43 届常年股东大会。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月初多次申报持股变动，需留意其持股比例变化。
凭单转换与 ESOS 行使持续小幅增加已发行股本。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 8,817.36 百万，环比增长 16.5%，同比增长 15.3%；净利为 MYR 327.56 百万，环比增长 0.5%，但同比下降 47.1%，净利率从 4.3% 降至 3.7%。

recent_en: YTL has been issuing new shares in batches from warrant conversions and ESOS exercises, while EPF filed multiple changes in its substantial shareholder interest from October to early November.
notable_en: Warrants were converted into ordinary shares through several new share issuances at RM1.50 per share.
New shares were issued from ESOS option exercises at RM0.46 per share.
The 43rd Annual General Meeting will be held on 3 December 2026.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in its substantial shareholder interest from October to early November; its shareholding level should be monitored.
Warrant conversions and ESOS exercises continue to modestly increase the issued share capital.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 8,817.36 million, up 16.5% QoQ and 15.3% YoY; net income was MYR 327.56 million, up 0.5% QoQ but down 47.1% YoY, with net margin declining from 4.3% to 3.7%.
